selection: Maximum fixed 128-path, 64-step validation return at every 20 iterations. No final-test payoff is used for training or checkpoint selection.
training_uncertainty: Each of ten seed-level policies is reported separately. Across-seed ranges and standard deviations are descriptive algorithmic variability, not Monte Carlo confidence intervals.
scope: Unchanged capital primitives and competitors. Newly specified innovation-driven sampled implementation; exact economic diffusion is neither stopped nor clipped. Fixed initial states, conditional simultaneous statistical bounds; no population calibration and no optimizer convergence claim.
declaration: This protocol is fixed after exploratory development on seed 2027 and a disjoint noise bank, before the final remote fits. It is not preregistration before all research. Every failed and incomplete run is retained. No failed run is replaced by another seed.

tail_profile_stress.shape: normalized Student t(3) cross-sectional quantiles; fixed vector, not random initial law

legacy_greedy.interpretation: direct-full critic followed by a validation-tuned radius projection is a conservative hybrid, not unrestricted direct-full deployment
